content.what_it_is: MATLAB function that loads additional spectrum configuration from inputs.mat, randomly moves guest frequencies onto the next non-lower host frequency until a target coherent-component count is reached (L1-L48), then evaluates a TMA/JONSWAP-like frequency spectrum and directional Fourier weight, calibrates total energy to Hmo, and returns coherent frequencies, spectral energy, per-component Hmo, repetition counts, and AG (L49-L89).
entities: function Coherence_Spectrum with outputs freq_out, Spectrum_Energy, Hmo_each, reps, and AG declared at L1-L2
inputs idx_theta, freq_in, freq_resolution, theta, and host_freqs_idx declared at L2
host frequencies host_freqs defined at L11
guest pool freqs_pool defined at L14 and reduced at L33
target Num_Coherent defined at L17
mutable frequency list freq_temp defined at L19
repetition vector reps defined at L21 and updated at L42-L43
current coherent count Num_Coherent_temp defined at L26 and updated at L45
pool length mfreq_temp, random guest_idx, and guest_freq_temp defined at L29-L31
host differences/index/frequency/whole index defined at L35-L39
coherent_idx defined at L44
final coherent frequency vector freq_coherent defined at L48
Energy_total initialized and accumulated at L51 and L69
loop index kf defined at L52
dimensionless frequency omiga_spec and depth factor phi defined at L53-L58
spectral width sigma_spec assigned at L61 and L63
spectral arrays Etma and EnergyBin assigned at L66-L69
directional harmonic count N_spec defined at L72
AG initialized at L73 and accumulated at L75-L76
harmonic index k_n defined at L74
energy calibration alpha_spec and correction_coeff defined at L80-L81
corrected outputs AG, Hmo_each, and Spectrum_Energy defined at L83-L85
diagnostic Hmo_output defined at L87
freq_out assigned at L89

equations.ref: target coherent-component count from loaded configuration
random guest position in remaining pool

unresolved: Function-interface violation at L1-L5: load inputs.mat injects hidden dependencies (including Coherent_Percentage, mcomponent, mfreq, depth, g, fp, gamma_spec, sigma_theta, theta_mean, and Hmo) directly into the local workspace and can overwrite same-named explicit inputs. The declared idx_theta input is never used anywhere.

Pool-exhaustion/range defect across L17 and L27-L33: Num_Coherent is not bounded by the achievable pool/count. If the target cannot be reached, mfreq_temp becomes zero and guest_idx becomes zero, making freqs_pool(0) invalid; ceil(rand*mfreq_temp) can also produce zero if rand returns exactly zero.

Invalid-host fallback at L35-L39: when a guest frequency exceeds every host, all freq_diff entries become Inf, yet min selects the first host and the guest is moved to a lower frequency despite the preceding exclusion rule. An empty host_freqs vector is likewise unhandled.

Counting can overshoot or misrepresent the target across L42-L45: reps is propagated to every frequency equal to a host, and coherent_idx counts both hosts and all guests with reps>1. The while condition only requires the count to reach/exceed Num_Coherent, not equal it.

Shape/interface assumptions: reps is sized from loaded mfreq at L21 while indexing uses freq_in/host indices; theta(kf), EnergyBin, and AG assume all loaded/input lengths and orientations agree, without validation.

Singularity checks are absent across L53-L85: nonpositive frequency/fp, nonpositive depth/g, zero sigma_theta, zero Energy_total, zero sum(AG.*EnergyBin), or zero freq_resolution can create Inf/NaN or division by zero. N_spec at L72 is also not forced to an integer before use as a loop bound.
The claimed output-height check at L86-L87 only computes Hmo_output and never compares it with Hmo or raises a diagnostic, so failed energy calibration is not detected.
